notes.title: Crystal Gaiden Origins Patch #3 - Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes: [p]Hello gamers![/p][p]Crystal Gaiden Origins receives another round of improvements and fixes![/p][p][b]⚙️ Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New:[/b] Leaderboard for Boss Rush mode—come compete with the dev team's record![/p][/*][*][p][b]New:[/b] Improved Title UI with better spacing and enhanced accessibility[/p][/*][*][p][b]New:[/b] Restart option added to Time Trial mode for faster retry[/p][/*][/list][p]We appreciate all your love and support![/p][p][b]Team Oni[/b][/p]

notes.title: Crystal Gaiden Origins Patch #2 - Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes: [p]Hello gamers,[/p][p]Crystal Gaiden Origins gets another round of improvements and fixes![/p][p]⚙️ Patch Notes[/p][list][*][p][b]New:[/b] All echo fragments and related achievements are now available in the game[/p][/*][*][p][b]New:[/b] Added ammo limits for each sub weapon with notifications when reaching max ammo[/p][/*][*][p][b]New:[/b] Added a buffer to sliding for jump inputs in the last few frames to create smoother control[/p][/*][*][p][b]New:[/b] Extended intro song to allow more relaxed pacing for intro texts in all languages—now you have time to read them all[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] a visual problem in 2-1 causing the sky to have seam lines at certain resolutions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] an animation state issue when sliding off a platform[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] some tile gap issues at certain resolutions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] a camera culling issue in stage 5 that might be related to enemies not behaving correctly[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] an animation state issue with an enemy in stage 5—it will now properly blink on hit at higher difficulties[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed[/b] an issue in Boss Rush mode preventing players from switching weapons in the first round[/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed[/b] stage 4 enemy behavior and spawn points to make it more challenging and engaging[/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed[/b] stage 5 enemy behavior so their attacks are more likely to land on the player[/p][/*][/list][p]We appreciate all the reports and suggestions from the community![/p][p]Team Oni[/p]

notes.title: Crystal Gaiden Origins Patch #1 - Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello gamers,[/b][/p][p]We've made some more polish and fixes for Crystal Gaiden Origins![/p][p][b]⚙️ Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]New: Echo fragments are now in the game to give more insight into the world and story (ongoing content expansion—not all stages have them at the moment)[/p][/*][*][p]New: Players can pick up the same type of weapon without waiting[/p][/*][*][p]New: Hidden items now grant full heal and 1up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential save file corruption bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera lock segment stutter and situations where players get permanently stuck outside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a progression issue when the Stage 1 mini boss gets knocked out of the camera lock area[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced items in drop pods to make some parts of the game slightly more challenging[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI alignment tweaks and localization updates[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/p][p][b]Team Oni[/b][/p]

notes.title: Crystal Gaiden Origins Hotfix 1 - Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello gamers,[/b][/p][p]We're thrilled that you're enjoying the release of Crystal Gaiden Origins! [/p][p]We've been listening to your feedback and suggestions, so here are some key fixes and improvements we've implemented:[/p][p][b]⚙️ Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed text indentation issues affecting multiple language localizations[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved UI display problems in Boss Rush mode[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Stage 2 visuals to make environmental hazards more clearly visible[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Stage 3 and Stage 6 difficulty for better balance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Stage 6 Hidden Item achievement not unlocking properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Stage 6 environmental hazard collider[/p][/*][*][p]Added music, ending text and auto skip for outro[/p][/*][*][p]Added Portuguese and Traditional Chinese language support[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/p][p][b]Team Oni[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update - Difficulty Balance
notes.notes: [p]We've just pushed an update to the demo build based on your feedback![/p][p][b]What's New:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added more default lives for the demo to reduce frustration from repeated restarts[/p][/*][*][p]Placed additional checkpoints throughout levels for better pacing[/p][/*][*][p]Overall difficulty curve smoothed out to be more accessible[/p][/*][/list][p]This update makes it much easier to experience everything the demo has to offer without getting stuck on challenging sections. We want everyone to see what our game is all about![/p][p]Thanks to everyone who provided feedback - keep it coming as we continue polishing toward our full release.[/p][p][b]The demo is live now with these improvements. Jump in and let us know what you think![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706730/Crystal_Gaiden_Origins_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p]
